title: TypeSomething header
description: A sticky floating pill of white glass: a two-tone wordmark that types itself out, centred links with the current page as an acid pill, a language link and an acid CTA. While scrolling it slides up to the top edge and narrows; on phones a round acid button opens a menu panel.
notes: the tuck-on-scroll uses a CSS scroll timeline on the page (scroll(root)); without support it just stays floating
phone menu is a native <details>; JavaScript only drives the typing wordmark (turn it off with typing={false})
name: typesomething-header

props.name: brand
props.description: wordmark: bold first half and light second half (e.g. "Paper" + "kite")

props.name: brandIcon
props.description: small mark after the wordmark (a lucide icon or an svg)

props.name: homeLabel
props.description: name of the home link, for screen readers

props.name: language
props.description: language switch at the right (e.g. "EN"); left out when empty

props.name: cta
props.description: the acid pill at the right end

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: label of the phone menu button, for screen readers

props.name: typing
props.description: the second half of the wordmark types itself out on a loop
